description: This Java source file defines the abstract class LocalPlayer, which manages media playback using Android's MediaPlayer API. It includes nested classes for surface-based playback in SurfaceView and presentation overlays, providing functionality for local media control, handling surface lifecycle, and managing presentation displays.

classes.name: LocalPlayer
classes.description: Abstract class for local media playback using MediaPlayer, supporting SurfaceView and overlay presentation for video output.

classes.name: LocalPlayer.SurfaceViewPlayer
classes.description: Handles media playback via SurfaceView, managing surface lifecycle and presentation display updates.

classes.name: LocalPlayer.OverlayPlayer
classes.description: Handles media playback using overlay window, managing aspect ratio and overlay lifecycle.

classes.name: LocalPlayer.SurfaceViewPlayer.DemoPresentation
classes.description: Inner class representing a presentation display for secondary video content.

methods.name: isRemotePlayback
methods.description: Indicates this is local playback, returns false.

methods.name: isQueuingSupported
methods.description: Indicates queuing is not supported in this player.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases resources, stops and releases MediaPlayer.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts playback of a media item, setting data source and preparing media.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified position in the current media.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Updates media item status with current position, duration, and timestamp.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes playback if paused or else initiates playback if idle.

methods.name: onPrepared
methods.description: MediaPlayer callback when media is prepared.

methods.name: onCompletion
methods.description: MediaPlayer callback when media playback completes.

methods.name: onSeekComplete
methods.description: MediaPlayer callback when seek operation completes.

methods.name: updateSize
methods.description: Abstract method to update video display size.
